strings.en: I can read those moves easily!
Your moves are totally obvious!
I won't let you do as you please!
Its movements are light... Then I can do this!
If you're on this battlefield, I won't hold back!
My comrades deserved to die?!/　Don't screw with me! Katia, cut the limiter!
Y-Yes!
Limiter, release!
Emission slits, open!/　Thrusters, deploy!
Output to critical!
Here I go!!
I'll corner you!!
Take this, take thiiis!!
Not yet!!
Now, prepare yourself!!
Orgone Materialization!
Jua-Mu! Feel my rage!!
My comrades deserved to die?!/　Don't screw with me! Tenia, cut the limiter!
G-Got it!
Output, maximum!
My comrades deserved to die?!/　Don't screw with me! Melua, cut the limiter!
Releasing the limiter!
So-Des!/　I'll show you the true power of the Brigandi!
Katia! The Buster Cannon!
Y-Yes! Buster Armor, purge!
Double B Form!
Guide laser!
Connect!
Homing Missile!
You're not getting away!!
Now!
Here I come!
Orgone Buster Cannon!!
Extractor output, rising!
Ready! Go ahead!
Take this! So-Des!!
Tenia, purge the Buster Armor!
R-Roger!
Docking!
Launching armor bits!
Go, all of you!
You're not getting away!
Calvina, I've stopped it in its tracks!
Got you!
Take this!!
Maximum!
Orgone Materialization!!
Goooo!!
Melua! Purge the Buster Armor!
Y-Yes!
Take this!
Spread Shot!
Not yet!
Ragna Rifle, set!
Extractor, maximum!
Take this!!
I'll do it. With this Bellzelute!
Your moves are wide open!
With moves that sloppy?!
You came onto the battlefield, so prepare yourself!
If you're coming out, I won't hold back!
With the Bellzelute's mobility,/　a Big Shoulder is nothing...!
The Fury.../　Whatever your goal is, I'll never let you have it!
The Fury! I won't let you do as you please!
Damn the Fury... I won't let a single one escape!
I'll clean that thing up in no time!
Learn the power of the Bellzelute Brigandi/　firsthand!
With this Bellzelute Brigandi, I can do it!
I'll show you what the new Bellzelute can do!
You'll regret getting in my way!
I'll see right through maneuvers that sloppy!
With the Coustwell, I can do it!
Let's go, Coustwell Brachium!
I'll do it,/　with this Coustwell Brachium!
I'm attacking like this!
Yeah!
Calvina, attack...!
You don't need to tell me. I'm hitting the target!
I can see... the enemy's moves.
Keep your comments to yourself.
Hah, with maneuvers that easy to read?!
Calvina, you can read the enemy's moves...
The enemy's pulling away!
I can see that perfectly well!
Attack, and be ready to counter at the same time./　Can you do it?
It's not getting away. We're catching it, Tenia!
Got it!
I can trace its moves. We're good!
Then I'm attacking!
Extractor output stable./　You can do it, Calvina!
Then let's go!
With this Bellzelute's response speed...!
Yeah, we're good! Counterattack!
Tenia!
OK, you're fine to counterattack like this!
What are you gonna do, Calvina?!
Counterattack, obviously!
Tenia, let's do it. Trace the target!
OK, Calvina!
Tenia, you know what to do, right?
Yeah, no problem! Leave it to me!
Calvina, that enemy!
We can hit it. Let's go!
Output stable! Ready whenever you are, Calvina!
Well then, let's give it a try!
The Brigandi can catch up!
Still tracing it!
Tenia, I'm counterattacking!
Right! I've had the target locked the whole time!
Calvina, the enemy's breaking away!
Roger, pursuing!
The Coustwell should be able to do it too!
That's right, we can do it!
Katia, we attack and get ready to counter/　at the same time. Got it?
Yes, Calvina.
This Bellzelute can do it. Let's go, Katia.
Yes, no problems on my end.
Katia, stabilize the output!
Yes! With this... we're good!
Extractor output stable. Go ahead!
Here I go!
Ready to attack!
Roger. Attacking!
You're not getting away! Katia!
Yes, I'll back you up! Go!
We're going on the counteroffensive! Got it?!
Yes, Calvina!
Calvina, now!
Right, counterattacking!
Katia, how's the energy flow?
No problems. We're good!
Katia, you can do it, right?
Yes, even with the Brigandi system,/　I'll back you up perfectly!
With this Bellzelute Brigandi,/　we can take on anyone!
Especially the two of us!
I can track every enemy in our field of fire.
Well done. Then let's go!
You think you can run from this Brigandi?!/　Katia!
Yes! Tracing the target!
I won't let it end like this!/　Katia, are we good?!
Right!
Tracing the target!
Then let's counterattack!
Output stabilized!
OK, I'll pull it off even with the Coustwell!
Melua, right after the attack,/　we're going into evasive maneuvers.
Yes, understood.
Melua, we're attacking.
Yes!
To bring out the Bellzelute's full performance,/　I need your support. I'm counting on you.
Yes, leave it to me.
Calvina, the output is stable!
Melua, stabilize the output!
Melua, we're counterattacking!
Yes, I'll back you up!
Sending evasive maneuver predictions!
Looks like we can do it... Leave it to me!
The target's trying to escape!
I won't let it!
Melua, we're attacking!
Yes, anytime!
The Brigandi is tough to handle, but...
Calvina and I will be fine!
Calvina, I've stabilized the output.
Roger! Engaging!
The Cytron Marker/　can lock onto the target anytime!
OK, let's go!
The Brigandi can do it even from this position!
Yes! Let's counterattack!
Now, let's start the counterattack, Melua!
Still tracking the target!
You won't get away!
Up ahead! A Lamaris Kaana!
OK. Let's go, Tenia!
No matter how many of you gather, I'll wipe you out!
A Kaana Type.../　I can't waste time on something like that!
Lamaris Kaana acquired!
Roger, attacking!
Calvina, that big Lamaris...
I know. We're striking first!
That thing... I kinda feel sorry for it...
Jua-Mu's goal is to kill us...!/　If we show sympathy, we're the ones who'll die!
Katia, if you worry about the enemy's circumstances/　on the battlefield, you'll die!
Y-Yes, I'm sorry! We're good!
Calvina, that person...
Don't say any more./　There's nothing left to do but fight.
Calvina, it's Fu-Ruu's Raftclans!
If you insist on getting in my way,/　I'll just beat you and force my way through!
Katia, I'm counting on you./　An enemy with that kind of resolve is strong.
Yes... I can feel it/　through the Cytron System...!
Melua, you need to steel yourself too./　You need that to fight an enemy like that.
Y-Yes, I understand.../　I'll do everything I can too!
The Zee-Gadin is no ordinary opponent./　Tenia, we're going all out!
OK, I'll stick with you all the way!
The Zee-Gadin, huh...!/　Katia, you're coming along for this!
Yes, I'll fight with you to the very end!
The Zee-Gadin won't be an easy fight./　Melua, are you ready?
If we beat that thing, this war is over...!/　Stick with me a little longer, Tenia!
Yeah, let's give it everything!
That's the final enemy...!
We'll sink it,/　the Brigandi and us!
The Cytron Marker/　has locked onto the XN-L!
Let's go, Melua!/　Your life is in my hands!
Just who the hell are you?! Answer me!
Those maneuvers... I've seen them somewhere...?
If I corner that one,/　the gray Thorn should show up!
Julian... You...!
That incident.../　Was it all set up by you people...?!
Jua-Mu!/　Go ahead and see if you can beat me!
You may know my habits,/　but I can read your moves even better!
I'll beat you and drag Al-Van out!
Don't think you can shoot me down/　just because you're in a Raftclans!
Jua-Mu! Don't think you can beat me!
Jua-Mu, I won't kill you! I'm taking you alive!
No matter what you're piloting,/　this Bellzelute Brigandi can take you!
You'll never get the Granteed Dracodeus/　or Princess Shana-Mia!
This time I'm putting you to rest, Jua-Mu!
I won't let my lead get away!
Calvina, that unit!
Same model as the one from that time.../　A Commander unit!
Answer me! What did that other Thorn do?!
That Thorn... I won't let my lead get away!
Even against a Fury Knight,/　this Bellzelute Brigandi can win!
I won't let you have things your way,/　Fu-Ruu Muru!
Fu-Ruu... Let's settle this. Here and now!
You killed everyone at Ashurey!/　I'll never forgive you!
Who you are, and why you did/　something like that...! I'll make you talk!
I'll stop that Thorn no matter what!
The gray Thorn.../　That one's not getting away, no matter what!
Al-Van!/　You'll regret not killing me/　that day!
I'm not the woman I used to be!/　I'm your enemy!
Al-Van!/　I'm your opponent! No one else gets to fight you!
Don't get cocky, Gu-Landon...!/　There's nothing you can accomplish on your own!
I bet you meant to save your own forces.../　but that's what'll be the death of you!
Gu-Landon Gortz, I'll take you down!/　For everyone at Ashurey!
What do you mean, it's being controlled...?!
I can't just carelessly get close...!
What on earth is going on...?!
Ngh... I need to focus on the fight...!
Th-Those things...!
I'll shoot it down before it can use that trick!
That's a Raftclans too...!/　Then I'll take you down as well!
I'm capturing you!/　With this Bellzelute Brigandi!
So-Des! You're not getting away!
What a ridiculous thing.../　If it's an enemy, I won't hold back!
Debudedabide,/　I won't let you do as you like!
Debudedabide!/　Whatever your goal is, if you show up, I'll smash you!
That thing.../　I wonder if it'll shatter nicely if I shoot it?
Go ahead and shatter, Crystal Dragoon!
Crystal Dragoon.../　If you're getting in my way, I'll take you on!
What a colorful bunch of monsters...!
Ridiculous skeleton...!
I won't let you, Skull Knight!
Skull Knight... I'll catch you!
So you brought Lamaris along.../　But it's pointless!
It's just enemies being controlled by an enemy...!
If they're unmanned, I won't hold back at all!
Controlled or not, they're the enemy.../　Nothing changes.
So the big shot finally makes an appearance?/　Try me, if you think you can!
Karo-Ran!/　Go apologize to Seldoa in the next world!
Karo-Ran!/　Because of your schemes, my comrades...!
Stay out of our way!
Hurry up and get out of the way!
Whatever your goal is, if you're an enemy...!
Whoever you are, if you're an enemy, I'll beat you!
I can't stand having a war started/　just because of the curiosity of someone like you!
So that Raig-Geios is the Commander unit...!
I won't let a woman like you do as she pleases!
Even if it's the Baran-Schneil.../　we'll shoot it down!
Gadisword's ace, huh...!/　I'll take you on!
Vort Nikolaus.../　You'll make a worthy opponent!
I won't let you stall for time. I'm ending this in one go!
We're getting through here./　By beating you, Reggiane!
Don't think you can make the Cross Gate your own,/　Herluga!
Herluga! You're not getting away!
It's a simple conclusion,/　but I have no intention of accepting it!
Sorry, since you only just showed up,/　but you're leaving right away!
XN-L.../　Your luck ran out when you showed up in front of us!
I've got no business with you! Out of my way!
Out of my way!
Don't get in front of me!
If you're going to get in my way...!
I told you not to get in my way!
Even if it's a new alien model, I'll shoot it down!
Hmph, it may be new, but it looks mass-produced...
So what if a new model shows up?!
Hah, to think I'd be fighting aliens again.
Aliens or whatever,/　if you get in my way, I'll shoot you down!
So the Zovorg are back.
Zovorg machines are nothing!
Aliens or whatever, if you're an enemy, I'll beat you!
I've got your data!
Golaikunru or not...!
A war merchant's lackey, huh./　Still an enemy all the same.
A recon-in-force unit is no match for me!
I'll have to watch out for its range.
Even if it's a high-ranking main unit!
Even if its armor's a little thick...!
I'll take down that Geios-Grude!
An Org-Valu... It might put up some fight.
Even a Zeranio-class, it all depends on where you aim!
I'll be your opponent!
Thick Cylinder... I'll shoot you down!
Don't think a Thick Cylinder/　can stop me!
I'll shoot you down, Big Shoulder!
It looks like a Commander unit, but... I'll take it!
A White Horn, huh. I'll take it down!
White Horn... I'll take you on!
To think I'd end up fighting something like that...!
This feeling... It's kinda creepy.
Give it a rest. I've had enough occult talk.
You again? What on earth are you?
I don't have time to bother with something like that...!
I'm not the one you're after, but...!
You're getting out of my way, Ares Geist!
Whatever it is, if it's an enemy, I'll just beat it!
Damn Lamaris, disappear!
Honestly, one after another!
Annoying. Hurry up and disappear!
I can't let something like that slow me down!
That's an obvious power-up...!
No matter how big it gets,/　it's just a mass of Lamaris!
An Ida Type... I'll wipe it out here!
I can't let it end in a place like this!
Gasbra locked! Shooting it down.
A Cupid, huh. Out of my way!
Don't think a Leonysis can stop me!
I'll make you regret underestimating me!
I won't let you do as you please any longer!
I told you I wouldn't let you!
If you're going to attack me...!
Hah, too slow to break away!
If you're going to get in front of me...!
You're still in my sights!
Where do you think you're going?!
After you attacked me?!
Wh-What?! You've got to be kidding!!
How disgraceful...!!
I-Is this as far as I go?!!
To be beaten here...!!
The Brigandi's going down?!
Th-The Coustwell!!
It's not over yet!
Don't screw with me! As if this is enough to stop me!
This might be getting a little bad...!
A direct hit?! On me?! Damn it!
I've been hit...?!
Ngh! If only the Tesla Drive in the legs were intact!
Have I been cornered...?! But not yet!
Damn, thrust is dropping...!
I can't afford to take any more hits...!
I held out only because it's the Brigandi...!
Did I rely too much on the Buster Armor?!
I never thought I'd be pushed this far/　in the Brigandi...!
This isn't the old Bellzelute! I can still fight!
Keep fighting, Coustwell!
Calvina, at this rate...!
I won't let it end! Not here!
S-Sorry, if only I were better at this...
Damage control first, apologize later!
There are alerts all over the place!
I know that!
Ngh! Tenia, hold it together somehow!
R-Right! I'll keep the thrust up!
Th-The right leg's Tesla Drive is broken!/　We're tilting!
Then I'll balance it out with the Orgone Rifle!
W-We took a direct hit! At this rate...!
Pull yourself together! Without your support,/　we'll both die here!
Tenia, hold it together somehow!
Right, I'm switching/　to emergency mode!
Ngh, I've been hit! Tenia!
The right leg motor's about to break!/　The Buster Armor's main connector/　is coming loose!
Calvina, we got hit! That's a lot of damage!
Keep it together!/　With your support, we can still manage!
I never thought we'd be pushed this far...!/　Katia, can you still go on?!
There are alerts everywhere, but... I'll manage!
Ngh, you've got to be kidding!/　I'm not ending it in a place like this!
I-I can keep it going, but/　one more direct hit and we'll be shot down!
A direct hit!/　The Bellzelute can't take any more!
This is bad...!/　Switch to emergency mode!
A direct hit... Damn it!/　Katia, what's the unit's status?!
DCS inoperable, multiple red alerts!/　I've switched to emergency mode!
Ngh, I won't be shot down in a place like this!/　Katia, are you OK?! You can still go on, right?!
Yes! I'll correct the errors on my end!/　I'm with you to the end!
We're hit! Heavy damage! Alert!
Katia, just hold on a little longer!
C-Calvina!/　The damage... At this rate, we'll go down!
I have no intention of dying!
Ngh, I completely misjudged the enemy's strength.../　Melua, how is it?!
Extractor efficiency and/　Cytron linkage are dropping!
N-Not yet! I won't be beaten in a place like this!/　Melua!
I-I'll keep it going somehow!
C-Calvina, the Bellzelute is...
Ngh... I won't be beaten!/　I can't afford to be beaten ever again!
Ngh, I was too careless./　I never thought it'd do this much to me...!
Switching to emergency mode!/　We can keep fighting with that!
Ngh! Melua, how is it?!/　Can we still go on?!
Y-Yes! I'll support you with everything I've got!
N-No.../　I can't believe this one's taken so much damage...
Don't give up yet! I will never be beaten!
Calvina, it's too dangerous to go on!/　Please fall back!
Be quiet!/　Even if the Bellzelute gets wrecked,/　I'll shoot down Al-Van no matter what!
Th-That person is strong!/　At this rate, this one won't hold out!
I know that!/　Even if it costs me my life, Al-Van will...!!
Calvina, it's no use!/　If we don't run, the Bellzelute will...!
I don't care what happens!/　If I go down, I'm taking him with me!!
I never thought a mere Lamaris/　could do this much damage! Honestly!
Please calm down, Calvina!/　I'll keep it going a little longer!
Ngh, did I misjudge it...?! Melua!
Y-Yes! The Lamaris are still approaching!/　It's dangerous to go on!
I won't let the Kaana Type have its way any longer!
I'm sending you the re-verified/　behavior pattern data!
I won't fall! Not until I've killed you with my own hands!
No good, my maneuvers aren't working...!/　Don't tell me the pilot is...?!
If I can be beaten by that thing, then revenge is...!
Damn that Thorn, it's good!!
Fu-Ruu! We haven't settled this yet!
Damn you, Fu-Ruu, so this is a Knight getting serious?!
Is this the desperate strength/　of a Knight who's made up her mind...?!
Tch, was I too focused on Al-Van?!
Ngh! Don't get cocky, So-Des!
My maneuvers are being read?!
No doubt about it, that's an enemy who knows me...!
Jua-Muuu!/　As if I'd be shot down by the likes of you!
You've done it now, Jua-Mu!/　I'll destroy that Raftclans myself!
I'm being pushed back?! Me, by that Jua-Mu?!
The humiliation of being beaten by you!/　As if I could accept that!!
Karo-Ran! I won't let you beat me!
I haven't gone down yet, Gu-Landon!
Who... Who would ever give in to despair?!!
Ngh, I never thought the Baran-Schneil/　would be this powerful...!
Ngh! I have to keep up/　with Vort's maneuvers!
I'll turn this around, Reggiane!
To think it could control/　the Cross Gate's energy like that...!
XN-L! I'm not going to be your prey!
Damn that Gomoudokka,/　reading my maneuvers like this!
Ngh! Being beaten by a clown?!/　You've got to be kidding!!
Damn fake dragon,/　I won't let you have your way any longer!
Tch! Damn that Skull Knight,/　it's got power for something so slim!
Damn aliens! I can't back down here!
I can't be shot down by the Zovorg now, of all times!
You can't let your guard down/　around the Geios series...!
A direct hit?! Damn you, monster!
Ngh! Looks like that thing/　isn't just rampaging around...!
Ngh, to think I'm having trouble with a Thick Cylinder...!
I can't even hold back a Big Shoulder...!
I can't keep up with a White Horn!
I've been hit?! By those monsters?!
Getting pushed back by mere Lamaris.../　How pathetic.
With armor this thin,/　I have to dodge every time...!
Ngh, not bad!
Hah, if you think this is enough to stop me,/　you're dead wrong!
I misread it?! Me?!
Taking a hit head-on.../　I'm still too soft...!
I can't worry about damage like this!
As long as the DCS works, I can still fight!
How dare you land a hit on this slim unit!
Not yet! The Bellzelute won't go down/　from something like this!
Tch, I didn't think I'd stopped moving...!
Damn the Fury,/　so they already know the Bellzelute's data.
The Brigandi's armor/　won't shatter from that!
Just because I've got the Buster Armor on/　doesn't mean my moves are slower...!
Not yet! The main body isn't damaged!
The old Bellzelute would've been wrecked...!
The Coustwell can still keep going!
We got hit!
You just sit there quietly!
Doing damage control!
If you don't want to die, make it quick!
I've been in situations like this plenty of times.
W-Well, it's my first time!
Ngh! Tenia, the unit's tilting to the right!/　Correct the balance manually!
We've been hit! Tenia!
Damage control active!/　No problem continuing combat!
Calvina, we're hit! That did a lot of damage!
So it seems...!/　Tenia, stay focused and back me up!
I've been hit! Tenia!
Within the DCS's tolerance. We're still OK!
Tch, to think I'd take this many hits...
But we're fine to keep fighting! We can still go!
The Buster Armor's been hit!/　We're still OK, but be careful!
I'm getting back in position. Back me up!
We got hit?! Katia, the unit's response is sluggish!/　Do something about it!
I'm sorry! I'm adjusting it now!
Tch, I've been hit... Katia, status?!
Damage control!/　Output's a little unstable,/　but we're fine to keep fighting!
We've been hit!/　Calvina, the output's become unstable!
Adjust it and keep us going!
Ngh, a clean hit! Katia, status?!
Yes, output's a little unstable,/　but I'll compensate on my end!
I can't fall back over damage like this!/　Katia, you can do it, right?!
Yes! I can still correct it. Go!
We've been hit! DCS active,/　response speed has dropped slightly.
Back me up!/　I can't back down in a place like this!
To think I'd take this many hits...!
I'm sorry,/　if only I'd supported you properly...
To think the Bellzelute would take this much damage...!
Within the DCS's tolerance!/　We can still go, Calvina!
Calvina, we got hit!
Still... We're still OK!
Tch, I misread it!
There's damage, but/　I can still correct it. We're OK!
Did I rely too much on the Brigandi's performance...?
But it's still within the DCS's tolerance!/　This one and us, we can still go!
Calvina, what was that...?!
Sorry, I misread it./　Melua, I'm counting on you to correct it.
Ngh, this happened before too...!/　But mock battles and real combat are different!/　Al-Van, I'll prove it to you!
Calvina, please don't get too worked up!
Al-Van! Damn youuu!!
C-Calvina...!
Calvina, you're too worked up! At this rate...!
Quiet! That one isn't an opponent/　I can beat in a normal fight!
Getting pushed back by a Lamaris Kaana...!
Output is getting a bit unstable!/　Please be careful with the controls!
Ngh, by a mere mass of Lamaris...!
Tch, to think a ghost like that/　could do this much to me.
Calvina,/　things aren't looking too good...
And I don't have time to waste/　on mere Lamaris!
We're still within DCS tolerance, but/　the controls are getting unstable!
That Thorn sees right through my moves?!
Damn it, that Thorn! I won't let it go any further!
Al-Van!/　I'm not beaten yet!/　This fight's only getting started!
It moves like it knows/　exactly what I'm going to do...!
My moves are being read like this...!/　Is it an enemy who knows me...?!
You've done it now, Jua-Mu!/　But I don't have time to waste on you!
Damn you, Jua-Mu!/　Is it the unit, or have you gotten better?!
Ngh, did I underestimate him?/　Is the Raftclans making him stronger?
How unlike me,/　to let you do this much to me...!
Damn you, Jua-Mu,/　so you've mastered your new model?!
Jua-Mu!/　Outwitting me... Not bad!
Landing this many hits on me?!/　Jua-Mu, you...!
Damn it, his moves have changed!/　He's stronger when he's not calm... What a pain!
Ngh! I'm supposed to be taking out Al-Van,/　so stay out of my way!
Tch! You've done it now, So-Des!
Strong...! Just what kind of enemy is that?!
It landed a hit?!/　Is it the Thorn's performance, or the pilot's skill...?!
Ngh! That one's Raftclans is fast too!
Tch! That Raftclans's moves are hard to read!
Is that one stronger than a Knight?!
Ngh! Knight Commander isn't just for show!
Tch! We'll be the ones cornering you instead,/　Gu-Landon!
So that woman's this skilled...!
I won't let you go any further, Golaikunru!
Ngh... Sorry, Fairy, but/　if I don't get serious, I'll be the one shot down...!
If I waste time on that woman, the Cross Gate will...!
There's no time! Hurry, the Floraga!
With a battleship, if I can latch on, I can manage!/　That's how the XN-L went down too!
Ngh! If I'm holding back on my end...!
Was I hit?!/　To take this much from such a ridiculous thing...
Damn fake dragon, not bad...!
Am I being pushed back by that skeleton?! Argh!
Ngh! The only one I want is the Thorn!
Um, about that last evasive motion...
I don't need advice!
I don't think I'm relying on data, but...!
Getting beaten by a monster like that?/　You've got to be kidding!
Damn that Ares Geist, its moves are hard to read!
If I'm struggling against Zovorg mass-production units,/　I'm hopeless...!
Tch, the Geios series is a pain...!
I'll hang in a little longer!
I'd like to think surviving that ship's barrage/　was thanks to luck...!
To think a Thick Cylinder would do this much to me...!
To think a Big Shoulder would land a hit on me...!
That White Horn sure moves well!
By something like a ghost...!
Tch, that's a lot of damage. Damn monsters!
Not bad, Lamaris./　But I won't let you do any more!
To end up like this against Lamaris...!
Monster, you're not bad at all!
I took quite a lot of damage...!/　Monster, I won't let you do any more!
To think you could land a hit on me...!
You hit me, but not by much.
An attack like that won't do much.
Tch, I messed up.
